fullContentHtml:
SSC 10+2 CHSL Final Result 2026 – Out – Full Details

Staff Selection Commission, SSC has released the Final Result for the post of Combined Higher Secondary Level Examination 2025 on the official website of SSC. This recruitment was released for 3131 posts. Applications for the SSC CHSL Recruitment 2025 were accepted from June 23, 2025, to July 18, 2025. The Tier-II examination was Conducted on 22 April 2026 (Reschedule). Candidates who had appeared in Tier-II Examination can download their SSC CHSL Final Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 23 June 2025
  • Last Date : 18 July 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 19 July 2025
  • Online Correction : 25-26 July2025
  • Tier-I Exam Self Slot Booking : 22-28 November 2025
  • Tier-I Exam Start On : 12 November 2025
  • Tier-I Exam City Details : 05 November 2025
  • Tier-I Answer Key : 08 December 2025 Available Now
  • Tier-I Result : 27 February 2026
  • Tier-II Exam Date : 22 April 2026 (Reschedule)
  • Tier-I Marks / Score Card : 19 March 2026
  • Tier-II Exam City Details : 01 April 2026
  • Tier-II Admit Card : 07 April 2026
  • Re-schedule Exam City / Admit Card : 17 April 2026
  • Answer Key : 20 April 2026
  • Post Preference Form : 19-25 June 2026 (06:00 PM)
  • FRTA Result : 17 August 2026
  • Final Result : 07 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-
  • All Category Female : 0/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.
